title: Paths in the Camarilla
summary: Why a Camarilla Kindred on a Path of Enlightenment is a rare outsider.

claims.text: A Camarilla neonate following a Path instead of Humanity is almost unheard of.
The one case the writer knows is a Toreador alienist of the late 19th century, set on the Path of Death and the Soul by a sire who sat on a primogen council.
Following a Path in the Camarilla brands the follower an outsider and draws suspicion.

title: Wights
summary: Vampires whose minds have fallen wholly to the Beast.

claims.text: Wights are driven by raw urge and are no longer able to reflect on their curse.
Folk remedies of mortal legend, useless against an ordinary Cainite, seem to work on wights: mustard seed delays them and thorns keep them out.
The writer reads this as a divine opening that lets mortals hold such creatures off.

title: Thin-Blooded Rumours
summary: Talk among Cainites about the last generation.

claims.text: Rumour says the thin-blooded cannot sire childer but bear the curse more lightly than other Kindred.
Stories tell of thin-bloods enduring sunlight for long spells, eating food and even fathering mortal children.
Serbian legend already spoke of the dhampir, a child of a vampire.

title: The Suspire
summary: The last trial on the road to Golconda.

claims.text: The Suspire is the final ordeal of a seeker of Golconda, and its outcome decides the rest of unlife.
Each Suspire is personal, aimed at the weakest parts of the seeker's soul, and nearly always touches on the seeker's clan.
Some include physical pain such as fire or sunlight to test control of the Beast, but the core of it is a journey into one's own lost soul.

title: The Unforgiving
summary: Followers of a cold Path that prizes secrecy and gathered knowledge.

claims.text: The Path values secrecy, reasoning that an enemy who knows nothing makes mistakes.
Its ethics reject emotion as tainted by the Beast, with fear, anger and love named as the worst.
Followers trust only what they perceive themselves, and check it more than once since even senses can be fooled.
They never pass up a chance to learn another Cainite's secret, and some sell information.
Almost all have high Alertness.

title: Path of Self-Focus
summary: A Path of self-knowledge whose followers are called Internalists.

claims.text: Its sins include overconfidence, laziness, relying on or controlling others, holding back the Beast without need, and skipping nightly meditation.
Internalists will let the Beast rage when the moment calls for it.
Followers study whatever helps them know themselves, and all of them come to learn Meditation in time.

title: Path of Harmony
summary: A Path for Cainites who seek balance between Beast and Man.

claims.text: Harmonists aim to keep a balance between the predator and the person and to deal with the world without guilt.
As they progress they come to see vampires as parasites more than predators, which makes living beside humans easier.
They are most common among Gangrel, Nosferatu, Brujah and Ravnos, and there are more of them in the Camarilla than in other sects.
Unlike some Paths, Harmonists do not scorn mercy or compassion.

title: Autarkis
summary: Kindred who live outside every sect.

claims.text: Autarkis have no mentors or support and learn by trial, error and pain.
Among the Gehenna-minded at the fringe are suicide-pact cults, groups racing for Golconda, and Cainite survivalists.
Secret desires are hard to hide among Kindred who read auras and minds, so some exile themselves for privacy.

title: Dark Thaumaturgy Paths
summary: New infernal Thaumaturgy and the price a demon asks for it.

claims.text: Invoking one of these powers takes a blood point and a Willpower roll at the power's level plus 3; a botch costs a permanent Willpower point.
An optional rule ties each path to a fixed price owed to the demon who taught it.
One power inflicts the pain penalties of lost health levels by touch without real damage; supernatural targets resist with Willpower, and a vampire cannot be forced into torpor by it.

title: The Darwin Society
summary: A club of young Kindred who began as a student debating society.

claims.text: It started as a mortal college club debating survival of the fittest, until a Malkavian Embraced the graduate student Palmer Ward.
Palmer Ward's sire died in a fire soon after, and Palmer survived alone before returning to the club.
Fearing a war between the sects, the Society left its city, moved south to a Camarilla domain and presented itself to the prince.

title: The Skirmish School
summary: A Sabbat club that runs daring contests.

claims.text: In one contest the Skirmish School and the Mercy Killers pack raced to steal an earring from Prince Marcel of New Orleans.
The prince destroyed at least one Skirmish School member who tried it under Obfuscate, and the Mercy Killers won.
Big Daddy Lopez and Widow Annie went on to host ever more dangerous games.
